segments.COL.1.3-3: Paul thanks God whenever he prays for the Colossians
segments.COL.1.4-6: Paul has heard of the Colossians’ faith and love
segments.COL.1.9-10: Paul prays that the Colossians will know God’s will
segments.COL.1.13-14: God rescued us and brought us into his Son’s kingdom
segments.COL.1.15-17: The Son is the image of God and created all things
segments.COL.1.18-20: The Son is head of the church and brings peace
segments.COL.1.24-27: Paul suffers for the church and shares God’s mystery
segments.COL.1.28-29: Paul teaches everyone and works hard for them
segments.COL.2.1-3: Paul struggles for believers in Colossae and Laodicea
segments.COL.2.6-7: Believers should keep living in Christ with thanks
segments.COL.2.8-9: Paul warns believers not to follow empty human teaching
segments.COL.2.10-12: Believers are complete in Christ and raised with him
segments.COL.2.13-15: God made believers alive and forgave all their sins
segments.COL.2.16-17: No one should judge believers about food or feasts
segments.COL.2.18-19: Believers must not follow those with false humility
segments.COL.2.20-23: Believers died with Christ and need not obey human rules
segments.COL.3.1-4: Believers should think about things above, where Christ is
segments.COL.3.5-8: Paul tells believers to put away sin and anger
segments.COL.3.9-11: Believers have put on the new self and must not lie
segments.COL.3.12-14: Believers should be kind and forgiving and put on love
segments.COL.3.15-17: Believers should let Christ’s peace rule and give thanks
segments.COL.4.1-1: Masters must treat their slaves fairly
segments.COL.4.2-4: Paul asks believers to pray for him and his preaching
segments.COL.4.5-6: Paul urges believers to be wise and kind to outsiders
segments.COL.4.7-9: Paul sends Tychicus and Onesimus to tell the news
segments.COL.4.10-11: Aristarchus, Mark and Jesus Justus send greetings
segments.COL.4.12-14: Epaphras, Luke and Demas send greetings to the Colossians
segments.COL.4.15-17: Paul sends greetings and tells Archippus to finish his work
segments.COL.4.18-18: Paul ends the letter with his own greeting
